mentions.name: Kanban board for university students (k.cote.sh)
mentions.description: This is a free, sign-up-free kanban board built primarily for university students. It handles assignment and quiz deadlines with support for time-zone quirks (Eastern or AoE/UTC-12), soft deadlines, and batched releases, and it filters out noise like office hours and announcements from Canvas ICS calendar feeds. It is deployed for mobile access.
mentions.problem: Trello and personal calendars fall short for online programs like OMSCS, where deadlines span different time zones, some classes use soft deadlines, assignments are released in batches, and Canvas ICS feeds mix in noisy events like office hours and announcements.
mentions.audience: University students, particularly those in online programs like OMSCS at Georgia Tech
mentions.source_excerpt: I built https://k.cote.sh which is a kanban board primarily for university students. I built it for myself as I'm currently doing the OMSCS program at Georgia Tech.
